data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error in the qwen model (HTTP 400 BadRequestError when auditing PKGBUILD), not by differing security assessments. The deepseek model successfully reviewed the same PKGBUILD and found it safe with standard packaging practices.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit PKGBUILD due to API error (HTTP 400), leaving the most critical file unreviewed
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be clearly distinguished from security findings in the verdict logic - a failed audit should not contribute to 'inconclusive' when another model successfully audited the same files

When multiple models review the same package and one fails due to tool error while another succeeds, the successful audit should be weighted appropriately rather than treating the error as a legitimate coverage gap
The audit system should implement retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur on critical files like PKGBUILD
